direct canonical Hosea coordinates and WEB wording
local OSHB/UXLC marker evidence already pinned by the primaries

route_comparison_summary.route_principle: Retain a complete enacted sign, accusation-to-consequence movement, recollection-to-appeal sequence, image chain, or judgment-restoration movement when a proposed child is unresolved. Preserve a child only when scene, speaker surface, form, oracle/stanza structure, refrain, or discourse reset is materially stronger than chaptering or retrieval convenience.
route_comparison_summary.self_correction: The frozen literary primary over-split the first two child-name cycles while merging the third naming oracle into its reversal, and it asserted four false MT spans across the local Hos.11.12-Hos.12.14 offset. This peer route restores the complete Hos.1.2-Hos.1.9 sign movement, separates Hos.1.10-Hos.2.1 as reversal, and uses corrected MT coordinates.
route_comparison_summary.textual_peer_adjudication: Accepted in two route-changing places: retain the section-supported Hos.6.11|Hos.7.1 seam with mandatory cross-boundary hydration, and keep Hos.13.12-Hos.13.16 whole while Hos.13.14 punctuation is unresolved. The losing 41-unit route remains recorded below.

crosswalk_correction_audit.cause: Local WEB coordinates were copied into mt_span across the known local Hos.11.12-Hos.12.14 versus MT Hos.12.1-Hos.12.15 offset.
crosswalk_correction_audit.remedy: This peer route supplies explicit verified MT spans for every recommended local unit and blocks any downstream alternate-numbering export that copies local coordinates.

route_positions.literary_42: seams after Hos.1.5 and Hos.1.7 but not Hos.1.9

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: Each birth-name scene should be a primary child, or the third name should merge directly with its reversal.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: The repeated conception/birth/naming pattern is cumulative and the samekh after MT Hos.1.9 closes the three-name sign sequence. Merging Lo-Ammi with reversal while splitting the first two names is structurally inconsistent.
seam_challenges.ruling: Keep Hos.1.2-Hos.1.9 as the primary enacted-sign narrative; place a strong seam after Hos.1.9 and keep Hos.1.10-Hos.2.1 as the reversal oracle.
seam_challenges.remedy: Offer the three birth-name cycles only as hydrated internal navigation, never as detached naming oracles.
preserved_losing_positions: Hos.1.2-1.5; Hos.1.6-1.7; Hos.1.8-1.9 are form-valid children under the sign parent.
The frozen literary 1.8-2.1 span is rejected because it conflates the final judgment name with its counter-oracle.

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: The mother's accusation/threat should end before blocked pursuit begins.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: The double 'Contend', embedded lover speech, and successive therefore clauses constitute one accusation-to-consequence lawsuit.
seam_challenges.ruling: Reject the primary seam and retain Hos.2.2-Hos.2.13.
seam_challenges.remedy: Index Hos.2.6 as an internal consequence turn under the mandatory Hos.2.2-Hos.2.23 diptych parent.
preserved_losing_positions: Hos.2.2-2.5 and Hos.2.6-2.13 remain useful display stanzas.

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: Renamed relationship should end before peace covenant, betrothal, and response chain.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: Wilderness allurement, renamed address, peace, betrothal, creation response, and name reversal form one restoration counter-movement. Correlated markers also support other internal breaks, so no single child seam is dominant.
seam_challenges.ruling: Retain Hos.2.14-Hos.2.23 as the primary route unit.
seam_challenges.remedy: Permit marker-backed stanzas only with mandatory whole-unit hydration.
preserved_losing_positions: Hos.2.14-2.17 and Hos.2.18-2.23 are a serious two-child display.
Hos.2.14-2.15; 2.16-2.20; 2.21-2.23 is a competing marker-sensitive display.

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: Cultic accusation and Judah/Ephraim warning should remain one broad unit.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: Hos.4.15 resets to direct concessive warning, negative imperatives, new Judah/Israel contrast, and a closing Ephraim-idol verdict.
seam_challenges.ruling: Accept the seam; use Hos.4.11-4.14 and Hos.4.15-4.19.
preserved_losing_positions: The baseline's Hos.4.11-4.19 remains a valid macro stanza, not the preferred child.

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: Mercy/knowledge/covenant breach should separate from Gilead and priestly crime.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: The place-linked accusations substantiate the direct rebuke; the lexical ambiguity at Hos.6.7 is not form authority.
seam_challenges.ruling: Reject the primary seam. Keep the full divine reply through Hos.6.11 in the final route.
seam_challenges.remedy: Expose Hos.6.8 as an internal geographic-indictment stanza only.
preserved_losing_positions: Hos.6.4-6.7 and Hos.6.8-6.10 are plausible children if Hos.6.11 is handled by cross-boundary presentation.

route_positions.textual_peer_39: Hos.6.4-6.11 then Hos.7.1-7.7 with cross-boundary hydration

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: The restoration/healing temporal clauses require a cross-chapter primary child Hos.6.11-Hos.7.2.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: A correlated pe closes Hos.6.11, and Hos.7.1-7 develops uncovered iniquity, royal complicity, and the oven-court portrait. English temporal continuity is real but not sufficient to overrule the section/form closure.
seam_challenges.ruling: Adopt Hos.6.4-Hos.6.11 and Hos.7.1-Hos.7.7. Treat Hos.6.11-Hos.7.2 as a mandatory cross-boundary relation/presentation hold, not a primary route child.
seam_challenges.remedy: When either side is retrieved, hydrate Hos.6.11-Hos.7.2 and display the unresolved temporal attachment without selecting punctuation.
preserved_losing_positions: The 41-unit literary/canonical route with Hos.6.11-7.2 is coherent and remains the strongest losing route.
A narrower Hos.7.1-7.2 plus Hos.7.3-7.7 display remains possible under Hos.7.1-7.7.

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: The dove image should begin a unit that continues through false cry and faulty bow.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: Cake, consumed strength, unawareness, pride, dove-like foreign calls, and the divine net form one failed-awareness/foreign-orientation movement. The samekh after Hos.7.12 then supports the woe-lament opening at Hos.7.13.
seam_challenges.remedy: Reject the frozen literary Hos.7.10 seam; preserve dove/net as the conclusion to the unawareness sequence.
preserved_losing_positions: Hos.7.8-7.10 and Hos.7.11-7.16 remains a coherent image-reset alternative.
Baseline Hos.7.8-7.16 is a valid macro image-and-lament parent.

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: The famous sow-wind/reap-whirlwind saying should close the trumpet/calf unit.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: Hos.8.7 begins the crop/swallowing consequence chain that continues through strangers, swallowed Israel, Assyria, and hired lovers.
seam_challenges.remedy: Keep Hos.8.7 with Hos.8.8-8.10; never retrieve Hos.8.7 as an autonomous proverb.
preserved_losing_positions: The baseline placement records a real causal tie back to the calf accusation but is inferior for local form.

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: Sowing/nations and altars/law/sacrifice should remain one broad judgment unit.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: Hos.8.11 begins repeated altar accusation, written instruction, sacrifice, remembered guilt, and forgotten Maker; it is a distinct cult-law movement.
seam_challenges.ruling: Accept the seam; use Hos.8.7-8.10 and Hos.8.11-8.14.
seam_challenges.remedy: Hydrate both to Hos.8.1-Hos.10.15 and record translation pressure at Hos.8.10 without merging.
preserved_losing_positions: Hos.8.7-8.14 is a valid sow/reap macro consequence unit.

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: Festival/exile warning and prophet-watchman reckoning should be one unit.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: The doubled arrival formula 'days ... have come' resets to visitation, prophet/watchman, snare, and Gibeah.
seam_challenges.ruling: Accept the seam; use Hos.9.1-9.6 and Hos.9.7-9.9.
seam_challenges.remedy: Keep Hos.9.7-9.9 under a narrow speaker-layout hold.
preserved_losing_positions: Hos.9.1-9.9 remains a useful festival-to-reckoning parent.

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: Wilderness fruit, fertility lament, Gilgal judgment, and wandering coda should remain one unit.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: The petition at Hos.9.14 climaxes the birth-loss lament; Hos.9.15 relocates the accusation to Gilgal and resumes first-person expulsion/judgment. Hos.9.17 is a coda, not an orphan.
seam_challenges.remedy: Mark the Hos.9.17 surface speaker shift internally while keeping it with the Gilgal verdict.
preserved_losing_positions: Hos.9.10-9.17 is a coherent fertility-loss macro parent.

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: Gibeah recurrence/chastisement should separate from the heifer-field appeal and battle consequence.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: Chastisement and binding lead into yoke/plowing; positive sow/reap is answered by wicked plowing/reaping and warfare.
seam_challenges.ruling: Reject the primary seam; retain Hos.10.9-Hos.10.15.
seam_challenges.remedy: Expose Hos.10.9-10.10 only as a historical-recollection child under the full progression.
preserved_losing_positions: Hos.10.9-10.10 and Hos.10.11-10.15 is a form-aware display pair.

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: Parental recollection should separate from refused return and Assyria consequence.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: The refusal and sword directly reverse the love, calling, teaching, healing, drawing, and feeding recollection.
seam_challenges.ruling: Reject the primary seam; retain Hos.11.1-Hos.11.7.
seam_challenges.remedy: Use Hos.11.1-11.4 and Hos.11.5-11.7 only as mutually hydrated stanzas.
preserved_losing_positions: The canonical two-child form is strong for display but risks judgment/restoration severance.

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: Falsehood/wind/alliances and the Jacob controversy should remain one cross-chapter unit.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: Falsehood/deceit at local Hos.11.12 continues as lies and foreign alliances at Hos.12.1. Hos.12.2 then explicitly opens a controversy with Judah/Jacob and moves to ancestor recollection and appeal.
seam_challenges.remedy: Use corrected MT spans Hos.12.1-12.2 and Hos.12.3-12.7; retain a meaning-only hold on the Judah clause.
preserved_losing_positions: Hos.11.12-12.6 remains the required ancestor-controversy macro parent.
No one-verse local Hos.11.12 child is allowed.

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: Merchant boast/divine rebuttal should merge with Jacob-wife and prophet-exodus recollection.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: Hos.12.12 begins a fresh Jacob-in-Aram comparison and repeated wife/tend/prophet/preserve parallel; Hos.12.14 closes it with repayment.
seam_challenges.ruling: Accept the seam; use Hos.12.7-12.11 and Hos.12.12-12.14.
preserved_losing_positions: Baseline Hos.12.7-12.14 is a valid merchant-to-prophet macro response.

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: Ephraim/Baal disappearance and Egypt-wilderness predator judgment should be one image unit.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: Hos.13.4 resets to direct divine self-identification and provider recollection; the predator chain is its therefore consequence.
seam_challenges.ruling: Accept the seam; use Hos.13.1-13.3 and Hos.13.4-13.8.
seam_challenges.remedy: Hydrate both to the Hos.13.1-13.16 death/judgment macro.
preserved_losing_positions: Baseline Hos.13.1-13.8 remains a valid rise-forgetting-predation parent.

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: King question and stored guilt/death crisis should remain one broad terminal judgment unit.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: The king question-answer closes at Hos.13.11 with a samekh; Hos.13.12 begins repeated stored-guilt language and a new childbirth/death chain.
seam_challenges.ruling: Accept the seam; use Hos.13.9-13.11 and Hos.13.12-13.16.
seam_challenges.remedy: Mandatory macro hydration prevents the kingship and death segments from becoming unrelated proof-texts.
preserved_losing_positions: Baseline Hos.13.9-13.16 is the mandatory terminal-judgment macro context.

seam_challenges.claim_under_attack: The Death/Sheol address closes before east wind and Samaria judgment.
seam_challenges.counterevidence: The rhetorical direction and punctuation of Hos.13.14 remain unresolved, and 'compassion hidden' may flow directly into east-wind and terminal judgment. Splitting here risks a promise-only later-reuse object.
seam_challenges.ruling: Reject activation of the child seam and keep Hos.13.12-Hos.13.16 as one lower-confidence unit.
seam_challenges.remedy: Record Hos.13.12-13.14 and Hos.13.15-13.16 as losing child options; hydrate the whole unit whenever Hos.13.14 is retrieved.
preserved_losing_positions: The 41-unit literary/canonical split is form-plausible and remains the preferred child proposal if external textual and human review later resolves the punctuation.
No standalone Hos.13.14 unit is permitted.

recommended_route.title: The Word to Hosea in the Days of the Kings
recommended_route.deciding_marker: The complete word-event and regnal heading closes before the first narrated sign command.

recommended_route.title: The Three Children Named
recommended_route.literary_form: enacted sign narrative with three naming speeches
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Commission and enactment alternate with three repeated birth/name cycles and close after Lo-Ammi.

recommended_route.title: The Names Reversed and One People Gathered
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Not-my-people is reversed through children, gathering, Jezreel, and the paired My-people/My-loved-one commands before the lawsuit's double Contend.

recommended_route.title: Contend with the Mother Who Forgot
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Double Contend governs accusation, lover speech, blocked pursuit, deprivation, exposure, festival cessation, and remembered forgetting.

recommended_route.title: Allure, Betroth, Answer, and Sow
recommended_route.literary_form: restoration promise with betrothal and response chain
recommended_route.deciding_marker: The allurement pivot, repeated day formulas, betrothal anaphora, creation response, and restored names form one counter-movement.

recommended_route.title: Go Again: Enactment and the Many Days
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Go-again command, first-person purchase/address, and many-days/afterward interpretation are one sign-act sequence.

recommended_route.title: Hear the Charge and the Mourning Land
recommended_route.literary_form: lawsuit summons, charge catalogue, and cosmic consequence
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Hear/charge opens; therefore the land mourns closes the evidence-and-consequence stanza.

recommended_route.title: Like People, Like Priest
recommended_route.literary_form: priest-people knowledge accusation and reciprocal sentence
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Reject/forget reciprocity and like-people-like-priest bind the difficult opening to appetite and punishment.

recommended_route.title: Understanding Taken and the People Ruined
recommended_route.literary_form: vice maxim expanded into cultic accusation
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Prostitution/wine remove understanding; the spirit-of-prostitution and people-without-understanding clauses close an inclusio.

recommended_route.title: Do Not Come to Beth Aven
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Negative imperatives and Judah/Israel contrast lead through stubborn heifer, Ephraim, idols, and wind consequence.

recommended_route.title: Priests, Israel, and the House of the King
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Triple hearing summons and judgment-against-you lead to stumbling, failed seeking, and new-moon consequence.

recommended_route.title: Sound the Alarm: Moth, Wound, and Lion
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Horn/trumpet imperatives begin an escalation from decay and wound to lion attack and withdrawal-until-seeking.

recommended_route.title: Come, Let Us Return and Know
recommended_route.literary_form: communal return summons and healing confession
recommended_route.deciding_marker: First-person plural return/know appeals are framed by healing, revival, dawn, and rain before divine questions resume.

recommended_route.title: Morning-Cloud Loyalty and the Harvest Coda
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Double what-shall-I-do questions govern prophetic-word judgment, mercy/knowledge, breach, Gilead/priest crimes, and the Judah harvest close.

recommended_route.title: Healing Uncovers the Oven Court
recommended_route.literary_form: Samaria deceit and royal oven indictment
recommended_route.deciding_marker: When-I-would-heal opens exposed iniquity; falsehood and royal complicity develop into the repeated oven/fire court image.

recommended_route.title: The Unturned Cake and Deceived Dove
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Unturned cake, unnoticed weakness, pride, dove-like foreign calls, and divine net close at the samekh.

recommended_route.title: Woe, False Cry, and Faulty Bow
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Double woe opens divine intended-redemption lament and closes with false return, faulty bow, princes, and Egypt derision.

recommended_route.title: Trumpet, Covenant Cry, and Samaria's Calf
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Trumpet/covenant charge and disputed acknowledgment lead through unauthorized kings to the calf-made-not-God verdict.

recommended_route.title: Sowing Wind and Being Swallowed
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Sow/reap governs crop failure, swallowing, nations, Assyria, and hired lovers.

recommended_route.title: Altars, Written Instruction, and Fire
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Repeated altars open a law/sacrifice/remember-forget sequence ending in fire on fortified cities.

recommended_route.title: No Festival Joy in Exile
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Do-not-rejoice and harvest/feast language invert into lost land, polluted food, feast-day question, burial, and desolated tents.

recommended_route.title: Days of Reckoning and the Snared Watchman
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Doubled days-have-come opens prophet/watchman hostility and snare, closed by Gibeah remember/punish.

recommended_route.title: Wilderness Grapes and the Withered Future
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Found-fruit recollection reverses into no birth/conception and climaxes in the interrupted what-will-you-give petition.

recommended_route.title: Gilgal's Rebellion and the Wandering Coda
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Gilgal resets to expulsion/root/fruit judgment, and My-God rejection closes it as a coda rather than a one-verse orphan.

recommended_route.title: Vine, Empty King, and Calf Carried Away
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Vine/altars/divided heart yield empty royal speech, false covenant, calf deportation, floating king, and the mountain cry.

recommended_route.title: Gibeah, Fallow Ground, and Daybreak
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Gibeah/chastisement leads to heifer/plowing, positive sow-seek appeal, reversed wicked harvest, battle, and daybreak king destruction.

recommended_route.title: The Child Taught to Walk Yet Bent Away
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Caregiving verbs are answered by refusal to return, Assyrian rule, sword, and bent-away people.

recommended_route.title: How Can I Give You Up?
recommended_route.literary_form: compassion question chain and homecoming promise
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Four how-can-I questions turn threat into restraint, lion roar, trembling return, settled houses, and messenger close.

recommended_route.title: Falsehood Around Me and Wind Pursued
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Falsehood/deceit continues as wind/lies/desolation and Assyria/Egypt action before the controversy formula.

recommended_route.title: The Controversy with Jacob and Call to Return
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Controversy/Jacob recollection leads through Bethel and the divine-name formula to therefore turn, keep, and wait.

recommended_route.title: Dishonest Scales and the Tent Rebuttal
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Merchant/scales and wealth innocence boast are answered by Egypt self-identification, tents, prophets, visions, and altar heaps.

recommended_route.title: A Wife Tended, a People Preserved, Anger Repaid
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Jacob/wife/tending is paired with prophet/exodus/preservation, then closed by Ephraim provocation and repayment.

recommended_route.title: Ephraim Exalted, Guilty, and Gone Like Mist
recommended_route.literary_form: compressed rise-death history and vanishing-image verdict
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Exalted/guilty/died expands into more idol sin and a fourfold mist/dew/chaff/smoke consequence.

recommended_route.title: Known in the Wilderness, Met by Wild Beasts
recommended_route.literary_form: provider recollection reversed into predator judgment
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Egypt/wilderness provision and forgetting are reversed by therefore lion, leopard, bear, and wild-animal attack.

recommended_route.title: Where Is Your King Now?
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Helper/save premise opens king/judges questions answered by gave/took in anger/wrath and closed by a samekh.

recommended_route.title: Stored Guilt, Failed Birth, Death, East Wind, and Samaria
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Stored guilt develops through labor, Death/Sheol address, hidden compassion, east wind, drought, plunder, and the pe-closed Samaria judgment.

recommended_route.title: Return with Words
recommended_route.literary_form: return summons with supplied communal confession
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Return imperative and take-words instruction supply one confession through renounced substitutes and orphan mercy.

recommended_route.title: Healing, Dew, Roots, Shade, and Fruit
recommended_route.literary_form: divine healing response and flourishing image chain
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Heal/love/dew opens a sustained plant-fragrance-fruit chain capped by the disputed but context-bound Hos.14.8 answer/care/fruit line.

recommended_route.title: Who Is Wise to Understand the Ways?
recommended_route.deciding_marker: Paired who-questions and generalized right-ways/walk/stumble maxim reset from direct restoration speech.

mandatory_macro_hydration.form: superscription plus enacted naming cycle and reversal
mandatory_macro_hydration.hydration_rule: Any child-name or later-reuse hit must retrieve the complete sign-and-reversal context.
Judgment and restoration children hydrate bidirectionally.
Command, enactment, address, and interpretation remain one parent.
Knowledge, cult, warning, and leadership children retain the whole lawsuit frame.

mandatory_macro_hydration.form: alarm, return speech, divine reply, and political indictment
mandatory_macro_hydration.hydration_rule: Hos.5.15-6.4 and Hos.6.11-7.2 are mandatory cross-boundary context windows; no sincerity or punctuation ruling.

mandatory_macro_hydration.form: sowing-reaping, cult-monarchy, exile, and recollection judgment cycle
mandatory_macro_hydration.hydration_rule: Famous sayings, violence, prophet/watchman, calf, vine, and Gibeah children never retrieve without accusation/lament context.

mandatory_macro_hydration.form: parental recollection, consequence, compassion, and return
mandatory_macro_hydration.hydration_rule: Hos.11.1 and compassion/restoration hits hydrate both children.

mandatory_macro_hydration.form: falsehood, Jacob, merchant, and prophet controversy
mandatory_macro_hydration.hydration_rule: Corrected unit-level crosswalk is mandatory; no Judah-clause, angel, Bethel, or merchant lexical ruling.

mandatory_macro_hydration.form: death, kingship, stored guilt, and terminal judgment
mandatory_macro_hydration.hydration_rule: Hos.13.14 always retrieves the full Hos.13.12-13.16 unit and Hos.13.1-13.16 macro; no promise-only object.

mandatory_macro_hydration.form: return appeal, divine answer, flourishing, and wisdom close
mandatory_macro_hydration.hydration_rule: Petition, answer, Hos.14.8 capstone, and wisdom colophon remain mutually available while the Hos.14.8|14.9 seam stays explicit.

presentation_and_boundary_holds.not_a_hold_on: theology, speaker identity, or preferred punctuation

presentation_and_boundary_holds.route_effect: Keep the unit intact; allow alternate lineation inside Hos.9.7-9.8.
Keep the bridge and corrected MT Hos.12.1-12.2 coordinates; do not use the Judah clause to change the seam.
Keep the larger unit; preserve but do not activate the Hos.13.14|Hos.13.15 child seam.

presentation_and_boundary_holds.route_effect: Keep Hos.14.8 in Hos.14.4-14.8, expose the internal samekh, and do not create a one-verse child.

later_reuse_and_prooftext_audit.ruling: Keep the entire reversal oracle and hydrate to Hos.1.1-Hos.2.1; later reuse has no Hosea boundary authority.

later_reuse_and_prooftext_audit.risk: Later citation can turn mercy-not-sacrifice into an autonomous maxim.
later_reuse_and_prooftext_audit.ruling: Keep inside Hos.6.4-Hos.6.11 and hydrate to Hos.5.8-Hos.7.16.

later_reuse_and_prooftext_audit.risk: Later reuse of mountains/hills can detach the line from calf/high-place judgment.
later_reuse_and_prooftext_audit.ruling: Keep inside Hos.10.1-Hos.10.8 and hydrate to Hos.8.1-Hos.10.15.

later_reuse_and_prooftext_audit.risk: Later reuse can isolate one child/exodus line.
later_reuse_and_prooftext_audit.ruling: Keep inside Hos.11.1-Hos.11.7 with mandatory Hos.11.1-Hos.11.11 parent.

later_reuse_and_prooftext_audit.risk: Later reuse and familiar punctuation can create a promise-only death-rescue chunk.
later_reuse_and_prooftext_audit.ruling: Keep inside held Hos.13.12-Hos.13.16 and hydrate to Hos.13.1-Hos.13.16.

baseline_strengths: Correctly preserved Hos.1.2-Hos.1.9 as the complete three-name enacted sign.
Correctly preserved broad accusation-consequence, Gibeah-field, parental, and death-judgment parents.
baseline_and_form_label_audit.generic_form_guard: Every recommended child uses a real form label: superscription, enacted sign, naming-reversal oracle, lawsuit, restoration promise, summons, rebuke, lament, image chain, recollection, appeal, question chain, judgment movement, or wisdom colophon. Titles are not substituted for form labels.

coverage_proof.mt_crosswalk_rule: Every local unit is mapped through the verified Hosea offsets, including local Hos.1.10-Hos.2.23 to MT Hos.2.1-Hos.2.25, local Hos.11.12-Hos.12.14 to MT Hos.12.1-Hos.12.15, local Hos.13.16 to MT Hos.14.1, and local Hos.14.1-Hos.14.9 to MT Hos.14.2-Hos.14.10.
coverage_proof.proof_method: Expand each recommended local span against the 197-reference canonical Hosea inventory and require exact ordered array equality; independently expand each stated MT span against the OSHB Hosea verse inventory and require exact count parity and contiguous crosswalk order.
